about_the_game:
A dull thud was the last thing the dutiful Gardener Golem B3-RT heard before everything went black. Now almost 100 years later he awakens on a deserted island. And does WHAT??

GARDENING OF COURSE!!

Golembert is a management, gardening and story game with the following features:

  • Build your dream garden! Choose from a variety of pots, fields, raised beds and decorations and receive new designs from quests!

  • Discover your green thumb! Take care of your own plants in a well-thought-out circular economy inspired by permaculture - including a composting system!

  • Do magical stuff! Renovate the island, brew potions, find new recipes and help the little magical inhabitants of your garden to get new seeds from other islands!

  • Find friends & do quests! Be visited by two different ships and befriend their crew members to quest for or barter with them!

  • Protect your island! Meet the fire spirit Helio and help him protect your island from the evil machinations of an anonymous blackmailer...

This game will 100% include:

  • 12+ cute NPCs with more than 150 cute dialogues!

  • Chill 6h+ (main quest) gameplay with adjustable daytime length!

  • A lot of quests! (20+ main quests, 50+ sidequests)

  • Gardening with 12 different types of plants!

  • Potion crafting with 40+ potions! (both plant yields and potions are used to fullfil quests)

This game will NOT include:

  • Farming sim rudiments like fishing, mining, leveling, stamina, health or combat!

  • Life sim features like dating or building your own house! (you can decorate your garden though!)

  • Multiplayer (and we are sorry for that)

  • Roguelike deckbuilding (but the game comes with a frustratingly hard card minigame called Ershiyi - maybe that's something for you then!!!)

These lists are here as a disclaimer because we are a small two-people selfpublishing indie dev studio and Golembert is our first game. We will do everything to deliver you the game presented here. But some things (like all the points of the NOT included-list) are beyond our vision, possibilites, and/or capabilities. Please keep that in mind! :)

Oh, you are still reading? Then maybe consider following this game! C:
